visual_brief.subject: Claude Haiku 5.5 cuts small-model prices and changes migration semantics
verified_context: Anthropic released Claude Haiku 5.5 for high-volume, latency-sensitive work with lower tiered token prices.
Haiku 5.5 is the first Haiku-class model with adjustable effort.
Existing Haiku integrations must account for changed tokenization, thinking, sampling, prefill, and tool behavior.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: A much smaller instrument can now be tuned along a cost-versus-effort range, but it fits into the existing system only after several precise adjustments.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A compact faceted instrument seated in a calibrated cradle, with a single terracotta control arc changing its internal depth while several old connectors are visibly realigned around it.
must_show: a visual contrast between compact scale and careful migration

candidate_notes.A: Constitution-compliant but not selected. The compact instrument and active adjustment are story-specific, but the visible human hands and product-demonstration staging reduce continuity with the publication's more abstract editorial archive.
candidate_notes.B: Selected. A small faceted core passes through a deep adjustable aperture while legacy coupling pieces are realigned at the entrance. The composition makes compact scale, effort depth, and migration work readable without depicting a literal model mechanism.
candidate_notes.C: Constitution-compliant and viable. The layered instrument and single lever clearly convey adjustable effort and integration changes, but the centered appliance-like form is less editorially distinctive than candidate B.

crop_review.article_desktop: 1100 x 591 center-cover review preserves the compact core, adjustable aperture, and realigned coupling pieces.
crop_review.article_mobile: 359 x 193 center-cover review retains the core and layered effort-depth metaphor without losing the migration elements.
crop_review.thumbnail: 320 x 164 review keeps the small core and large aperture as a distinct two-part silhouette.

golden_reference_comparison: Direct review beside the Claude Sonnet 5.5 and Mistral Large 4 production illustrations shows comparable warm ground, charcoal and terracotta material masses, scientific abstraction, tactile cutaway depth, and confident negative space. Candidate B is more kinetic and close-cropped than the references, so golden-reference fit is scored at 88.
